name: Print Sheet
description: Lay one piece of artwork out n-up on A4, Letter or A3, with crop marks in the margin.
a11yLabel: Print sheet, {{default rowsOut rows}} rows by {{default colsOut cols}} columns of the same artwork

inputs.label: Artwork
inputs.help: The one piece of artwork every cell repeats. Paste a LOLLY TOOL LINK here (a share link from any tool, e.g. a name badge or a QR code) and that tool is rendered into every cell and re-rendered whenever the sheet is opened - or pick an image from the library, or upload one. The power combo: a Bulk from rows run gives you one link per row of your CSV, so a roster becomes a stack of per-person links, and each one drops straight into this slot.

inputs.label: Sheet
inputs.help: Paper size. Picking one also sets the export page size, so the PDF comes out at true scale.

inputs.label: Rows
inputs.help: Cells down the sheet. Rows times columns is capped at 40 cells a sheet.

inputs.label: Gap
inputs.help: Space between cells, in millimetres. Zero butts them edge to edge for a single cut between neighbours.

inputs.label: Sheet margin
inputs.help: Unprinted border, in millimetres. The crop marks live here, and most desktop printers cannot print closer than about 5 mm to the paper edge.

inputs.label: Crop marks
inputs.help: Short lines in the margin off every cell edge, to line a guillotine or a knife up on.

inputs.label: Cut shape
inputs.help: Straight cut leaves the cells square. Rounded corners add a dashed die line around each cell, the sticker-sheet shape.
